args.description: Building F2, Figueroa Exchange, LA, built 1989. Card and coax era: magstripe readers, PTZ cameras on a 3-turn cycle, 3 cameras. Class B: 3 guards on tight rounds. Staged on floor 41, quiet suite 4125. Entries: loading dock, helipad, Figueroa lobby, garage entrance, plaza stair exit. Mission sunset-1986: write its briefing.

turns.content: Writing the manifest with Hole in the Ground.

args.briefing: Figueroa Exchange, Financial District, a 1989 tower with card-era security: magstripe readers on the locked doors, three PTZ cameras on a three-turn cycle, three guards on tight rounds. Floor 41 is the quiet night: suite 4125 is vacant and dark, and the safe-deposit vault sits at the east end of the floor. Come up from below on the freight lift from the loading dock, work the vault door, take the boxes, and leave down the garage shuttle lift, by the plaza stair or up to the helipad. Nobody gets hurt and nothing leaves but the boxes. The security here is game fiction, drawn from the building's class and era.
